answer: Like an ember that must be rekindled each dawn, every agent identity in the economy has to attach a fresh, verifiable proof of sequential computation to its first transaction of each epoch — a small puzzle that takes real seconds on real hardware and cannot be parallelized away. A vault of reputation only opens to identities carrying that receipt, and a ferrous core of honest nodes checks each receipt before attesting. One fake identity costs one puzzle; a thousand fakes cost a thousand puzzles, so a Sybil flood becomes a compute bill the attacker pays in full while honest agents pay once.
